_comment: How photos and personal videos that arrive in Library's Import area are filed. The layout uses {year}, {month} and {day} (the date taken); the file keeps its own name. Refused files stay in the Rejected area for rejected_retention_days. A file must stay unchanged for settle_seconds before it is filed.
_comment_duplicates: The duplicates cleanup job finds exact copies already inside a space or the Shared Library and writes a report for administrators; nothing is removed without a person choosing it.
_comment_missing: How many days Library keeps what it knows about a file that was deleted outside Library (its notes, tags and Gallery spots) before removing that record. 0 means never remove. Library never deletes a file because it went missing.
